examples.text: Die von den Sensoren aufgenommenen Daten werden in eine Datenbank eingespeist.

examples.text: Aktuell werde erwartet, »dass bis Ende 2030 Offshore-Windenergieprojekte mit insgesamt knapp 27 Gigawatt ins Netz einspeisen können«, heißt es in dem Bericht »Status des Offshore-Windenergieausbaus in Deutschland «.

Technik: etwas fortwährend einem bestehenden System hinzufügen

glosses: To push or pump (something, especially fluids) into a cavity or passage.

examples.text: The nurse injected a painkilling drug into the veins of my forearm.

glosses: To introduce (something) suddenly or violently.

examples.text: Punk injected a much-needed sense of urgency into the British music scene.
Caesar also, then hatching tyranny, injected the same scrupulous demurs.

glosses: To administer an injection to (someone or something), especially of medicine or drugs.

examples.text: Now lie back while we inject you with the anesthetic.
to inject the blood vessels

glosses: To take or be administered something by means of injection, especially medicine or drugs.

examples.text: It's been a week since I stopped injecting, and I'm still in withdrawal.

glosses: To introduce (code) into an existing program or its memory space, often without tight integration and sometimes through a security vulnerability.

examples.text: A quick test to see if I can inject SQL data is to enter my username and password as 'a.
Yes, you'll have to use CreateRemoteThread to "inject code" if you want information like the current directory of a process (at least on NT 3.5x).
As soon as a virus programmer discovers that some popular ActiveX thing has a bug that can be exploited, e.g. with controlled crashes to inject code, it's going to be a disaster.
DOM XSS is an unusual method for injecting JavaScript into a user's browser.
The AJAX controls inject the appropriate JavaScript code into the HTML output stream without you needing to code any JavaScript yourself.

glosses: To cast or throw; used with on.

examples.text: And mound inject on mound.

glosses: To introduce or add (something that is different or foreign).

examples.text: inject something into orbit
inject some spice into my life

This passage seems unfortunately to have set the tone, among English writers, for comment on the expedition, and quite wrongly since Gamitto used his donkey to inject some much needed light relief among the difficulties and privations of the journey.
Although you must admit that'd inject some spice into my life.
Launchers can inject in orbit several satellites per launch since LEO and MEO satellites are usually smaller than GEO satellites.
Someone with a rudimentary knowledge of a language may inject words of that new language into sentences to indicate a desire to identify and affiliate.

glosses: Introduire un liquide dans l’organisme par le moyen d’une seringue ou de tout autre instrument, en parlant du liquide comme de la partie dans laquelle se fait l'injection.

examples.text: La peroxydase du raifort en intraveineux ne passe pas dans le tissu cérébral, alors qu’elle diffuse très facilement dedans lorsqu’elle est injectée dans le LCR et pompée par les astrocytes.

glosses: Introduire une matière colorée, ou du mercure, dans les vaisseaux d’un cadavre, soit pour le conserver, soit pour rendre ces parties plus apparentes et pour en faciliter la dissection.

examples.text: Injecter un cadavre.
Injecter les veines, les artères.
